candidate.title: Pseudo-Seq
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina Pseudo-Seq schematic, interpreted as the poly(A)-selected RNA implementation clarified by Carlile et al. (PMID 25192136). It depicts one route from prepared RNA through CMC/OH− chemistry, 3′ adaptor ligation, RT, cDNA size selection, cDNA circularization and PCR-purified DNA. The left residue illustration is a legend; multiple fragment/circle icons are product examples, with no explicit alternative route. PSI-seq, Ψ-Seq, CeU-Seq, and ARTseq appear only in surrounding comparison text and are not target workflows. This record preserves schematic order while explicitly resolving the preparative RNA size-selection placement from primary text.
